title: Singular Morse-Smale Flows on Pseudomanifolds with Spherical-Cone Singularities: Conley Theory and Intersection Homology
summary: Classical Morse-Conley theory provides powerful tools for relating dynamical and topological invariants of smooth manifolds. In this paper, we extend this perspective to pseudomanifolds with spherical-cone singularities. By introducing and investigating singular Morse-Smale flows on pseudomanifolds with isolated singularities whose links are homeomorphic to finite disjoint unions of spheres.
